rulings.text: The one venue is said with «внутри» + genitive: «Исторический квартал Эль-Фридж внутри форта муниципалитета Аль-Ахсы». The reader's P1 surprise (a quarter inside a fort) is the fact the owner ruled, not an inversion produced by Russian syntax; the line parses one way only.

blind_disposition.disposition: Goal met: one venue, the quarter within the fort.

blind_disposition.item: P1 quarter inside a fort feels inverted
blind_disposition.disposition: Rejected as a syntax fault: it is the owner's fact (the Freej is inside the fort); the reader settled on the right reading.
